concerns.text: Task T010 ('Setup code/data/raw/ directory with checksum verification logic') is marked as unchecked [ ] and lacks a concrete implementation step. The plan.md (Phase 0, Step 1) and Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) explicitly require checksumming of raw artifacts. Without a defined task to implement this logic (e.g., a script or library integration), the requirement for data hygiene is unmet.

Task T011b ('Implement full 5-Fold LLSO logic') is marked [ ] and depends on T011a which contains '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM]' markers. The spec (FR-008) and plan (Phase 1, Step 5) mandate 5-Fold LLSO. The current task state indicates the logic is not yet defined or implementable, blocking the entire data pipeline (US1, US2, US3) which relies on valid splits.

Task T016b ('Implement scarcity flag logic') is marked [ ]. FR-001b requires the system to flag data scarcity if the count < 120. Without this task being defined and executable, the system cannot satisfy the requirement to handle insufficient data gracefully as per the spec.

Tasks T017a-c (Sensitivity analysis and cutoff selection) are marked [ ]. The spec (Assumption 5) and plan (Phase 0, Step 3) require robustness checks on graph construction cutoffs. These tasks are prerequisites for T017c (final graph generation) and T019 (splits generation). Their absence leaves the data ingestion pipeline incomplete.

All implementation tasks for User Story 2 (GNN Training and Prediction) are marked [ ]. This includes the SchNet architecture (T022), ensemble logic (T023a/b), training loop (T024), prediction generation (T025), and metrics calculation (T027b). FR-003, FR-004, FR-007, SC-001, SC-004, and SC-005 are entirely unaddressed by executable tasks.

All implementation tasks for User Story 3 (Error Analysis) are marked [ ]. This includes feature importance (T031), statistical testing (T033), and speed analysis (T035). FR-005, FR-006, SC-002, SC-003, and SC-005 are unaddressed. T030 (integration test) is also missing.

Task T037a (DFT baseline calculation) is marked [ ]. SC-004 requires measuring the speed-up factor against a DFT baseline. Without this task, the speed metric cannot be generated, and T035 (speed analysis) cannot execute.

Polish and cross-cutting tasks (T038-T042b) are marked [ ]. T042a/b are critical for updating the spec to reflect the plan's deviations (FR-006, FR-008). Without these, the 'Single Source of Truth' (Constitution Principle IV) is violated as the spec remains contradictory to the implementation plan.

Tasks T013 and T014 are marked [X] (complete) but T012a and T012b (Foundational contract/integration tests) are marked [ ]. T013/T014 are duplicates of T012a/T012b. The presence of duplicate tasks with conflicting completion statuses creates ambiguity. T012a/b should be the canonical tasks, and T013/T014 should be removed or merged to avoid confusion.
